title: Junction-case-sink transient thermal network with a required interface layer

provenance.citation: JEDEC JESD51-14 transient thermal impedance; Incropera and DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer
provenance.locator: thermal resistance network and transient thermal impedance
provenance.note: Model structure only; layer values must come from revision-bound datasheet or measurement.

terminology.definition: A ladder of physical thermal resistances and capacitances from junction through case and interface to ambient.
The thermal resistance of the interface material and mounting between the device case and the heatsink.

provenance.note: A missing interface is unknown, not zero.

models.name: Three-node Cauer thermal network with steady-state and transient response

provenance.citation: Incropera and DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer
Incropera and DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer

assumptions.statement: The thermal path is a three-node lumped Cauer network; spreading and multi-dimensional effects are outside the model.
Layer resistances and capacitances are constant over the analyzed temperature excursion.
The case-to-sink interface is a required physical layer; a missing interface resistance makes the network incomplete.

validity_domains.statement: The analysis applies while layer properties remain constant and the power step is the only forcing function.
exclusions: multi-dimensional spreading not represented by the lumped nodes

validity_domains.statement: All three resistances, including the interface, must be sourced for the actual assembly; transient analysis also requires all layer capacitances.
exclusions: missing layer capacitance for transient analysis
natural convection assumed where forced convection is required

property_sources.authority: Revision-bound datasheet plus JESD51 measurement condition
Interface material datasheet at the assembly pressure and thickness

provenance.note: Missing interface data is unavailable, not zero.

property_sources.authority: Revision-bound transient thermal impedance or calorimetric data

design_rules.rule: Include the case-to-sink interface resistance; never treat a missing interface as zero.
design_rules.check: R_th,cs has a revision-bound source and is strictly positive

design_rules.rule: A transient result requires all layer capacitances; a steady-state result does not establish transient margin.
design_rules.check: all C_th values present and positive

manufacturing_rules.rule: Control interface thickness, pressure and voiding because they dominate the case-to-sink resistance.
manufacturing_rules.check: assembly instruction and first-article thermal measurement

failure_modes.cause: thermal cycling, inadequate pressure or contamination
failure_modes.detection: rising case-to-sink delta and transient thermal impedance

diagnostic_signatures.signature: case-to-sink temperature difference rising faster than power or airflow explains

test_methods.method: Measure transient thermal impedance from junction to ambient on the actual assembly
test_methods.measures: layer resistances, capacitances and interface condition

standards_mappings.scope: transient thermal impedance measurement of semiconductor packages

worked_cases.description: A 50 W step into a 0.5/0.2/1.0 K/W junction-case-sink-ambient network from 25 degC reaches 110 degC junction at steady state.

provenance.citation: Closed-form solution of the declared three-node network
provenance.note: Fixture values are synthetic, not a datasheet.

counterexamples.claim: Junction-to-case plus sink-to-ambient resistance is the complete thermal path.
counterexamples.refutation: The omitted case-to-sink interface can dominate the temperature rise. A missing value is unknown, not zero, so the junction temperature is unavailable or the network is refused.

known_traps.trap: Summing only junction-to-case and sink-to-ambient resistance, or treating the missing interface as zero.
known_traps.why_shallow_fails: The arithmetic is valid only for the supplied layers; the omitted interface is an unknown thermal resistance, not a zero.
known_traps.guard: Require a revision-bound interface resistance or return a typed refusal/unavailable result.
